notes:
High-level: enterprise healthcare analytics vendor evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing support and internal doc search. Primary blockers are security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) and vendor intake. Key asks: 1) formal SIG/CAIQ package + supporting evidence (logs, certs) 2) explicit shared-responsibility matrix for private VPC setup 3) KMS/HSM integration pattern and ability for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS + CloudHSM or external HSM) 4) audit logging retention policy (90/365/730 days options) and streaming of logs to customer SIEM 5) data residency — must ensure EU residency for EU patient data and US for PHI, plus BAA discussion.

From calls: "If keys leave our control we need strict attestations and HSM-backed KMS" (CTO). Security lead: "We need the vendor CAIQ filled and evidence attachments — screenshots or certs for SOC2/ISO claims." Legal: "BAA required before production. Also want a clear incident response SLA and breach notification timeline."

Architecture preferences / constraints: VPC peering preferred, no public IP egress for inference; private control plane acceptable if it uses a customer-managed VPC endpoint; optional on-prem variant for air-gapped pilots. Expectation: Redwood provides an HSM-compatible integration path (bring-your-own-KMS) and audit logging to a customer-owned S3/GCS bucket or SIEM ingestion (Syslog/HTTPS). Tail-latency SLO target for chat use-case: 150ms median, 350ms p95 for short prompts; throughput baseline for PoC: 120 req/s with batching tuned for cost. Token cost target is tight — they want Redwood Optimize recommendations and quantization plan included in proposal.

Action items assigned: Redwood to return annotated SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet + CAIQ evidence links; SE to produce shared responsibility matrix mapping network, key management, logging, and backup responsibilities; legal to draft BAA clause options. PoC timeline: 4 weeks technical, then 2 weeks security validation. Procurement target: 2026-04. Notes logged and artifacts attached in Drive and Fireflies.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): private control-plane setup in customer VPC, basic routing, sample routing policy for eu/us residency. Phase 2 (2 weeks): integrate customer-managed KMS, verify HSM-backed envelope keys, enable audit export to customer SIEM. Phase 3 (2 weeks): load test to 120 req/s and measure p95, capture cost numbers and Redwood Optimize suggestions. Security review concurrent: deliver SIG/CAIQ evidence and complete vendor intake by week 2.
